# GoStore

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online general-merchandise retailer in Uruguay on WooCommerce. Sells technology, tools, home, kids, pet, cosmetics, clothing, sports and outdoor products. States shipping to all of Uruguay; same-day delivery depends on the buyer's area.
